newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil steady, crude has little impact.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil steady, crude has little impact.

text.p: NWE cracked fuel oil prices were steady on Wednesday with jittery crude having little impact.

High sulphur barges traded around Tuesday's levels of $111-112 fob ARA, although activity was slower. An oversupplied straight-run market was likely to prompt Russian supplies to work their way into the barge market with bearish consequences.

High sulphur cargoes were also steady with the market unclear about demand into a U.K. end-user. Talk for the October requirement was heard around $114-116 cif NWE. Supply remains tight, but interest for September was not apparent.
Low sulphur cracked barges were heard offered around $115 fob NWE to disinterested buyers.
Low sulphur cargo prices were steady to a touch firmer. A deal on Tuesday was done by a major to an Italian refiner at high cif Med cif Italy +50 cents.

The main Med buyer was not seen active. Market talk was mainly on a floating basis. Sellers said the approach of colder weather indicated buying from the main Med customer would have to start for stock building. But, there was no sign of this.
